text: Organizers announced that Dr. Elena Vasquez will open the coastal resilience forum in Lisbon on September 9, 2024, focusing on rising sea levels.
The memorial lecture for James Okonkwo was held in Chicago on November 3, 2022, and drew researchers from several continents.
Auckland residents welcomed Mayor Priya Nair on June 18, 2021, when she unveiled the city’s new cycling bridge plan.
At a storm briefing in Houston on August 25, 2017, meteorologist Kim Alvarez urged residents to finalize evacuation routes.
Historians note that translator Samir El-Haddad signed the archive access treaty in Cairo on January 22, 1996.
Composer Yuki Tanaka premiered her chamber suite in Kyoto during the spring festival on April 2, 2019.
Activist Rosa Benitez led the river cleanup in Medellín on July 15, 2023, with more than two thousand volunteers.
In Berlin on December 10, 1989, engineer Dieter Braun presented early plans for reunifying the city’s transit network.
Archaeologist Amara Mensah reported findings from the Nile delta expedition in Khartoum on March 30, 2008.
Chef Marco Ricci opened a small regional cooking school in Bologna on October 5, 2015, emphasizing handmade pasta.
